svg.text: Diagram 1b — parties and the partner configuration block
partner configuration block, one per partner used
bank account details in the database (v6.1, D58)
Rules: a counterparty receiver sits in exactly one group; sender_return and partner_transit receivers are group-less; an account is
payable through a partner only with an approved DESTINATION_APPROVAL; a fee structure is a new row per version; partner_pricing agrees
with PARTNER.disclosure_style; a single-use account or endpoint names the one deal it serves. v6.1: bank details are rows of BANK_ACCOUNT_DETAILS (below).
Round 2 (Email OTP): SENDER carries the approver email and the registered chat group (email_otp_*, four columns, one set per sender); the switch is on PROJECT (1a).
